verdict.rationale: LegalZoom's annual-report page names the filing types it handles (initial reports, auto-filed annual reports, amendment filings, optional expedited filing) and publishes a pre-purchase price floor ('Starts at $99'), plus $249/year for registered agent with auto-renewal terms. It does not state which states are covered, and pricing is only a starting figure with no breakdown of tiers or state fees. The '†' footnote on auto-filing implies unstated limits. Missing for 10: explicit list of states covered, full per-tier and per-filing pricing including state-fee treatment, the content of the auto-filing footnote, independent corroboration of the disclosed pricing.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the filing service states which filings and states it covers and what it costs before I buy it

citations.quote: Initial report filing and auto-filing of your annual reports† to satisfy ongoing state requirements
Amendment filings with the Secretary of State for business changes
The service auto-renews at the purchase rate each year until you cancel.
